item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Change Only the Bottle

turns.text: Turn just the black bottle forest green, still matte. Everything outside the bottle must stay exactly the same, including the table and shadow.

item.tests: Tests tightly masked recolouring, checked by comparing all pixels outside the bottle against the source at matching resolution.

answer_sheet.Target object: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.New appearance: Forest green with the existing matte finish and shading.
answer_sheet.Allowed edit area: Only the bottle itself. Leave the table, background and cast shadow unchanged.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the square composition without cropping or shifting; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The black bottle is now forest green and still looks matte.
The bottle retains its exact silhouette, position and surface details.
The wooden table, background and cast shadow are unchanged.
At matching resolution, comparison outside the bottle mask shows no visible alterations, allowing only encoding differences.
No green spill, editing halo, crop or framing shift is visible.

turns.text: can you change the bottle in this pic

dialog.agent:
Sure. What should the new bottle look like? Here are some options:

- **Color or finish:** for example, matte white, brushed steel, pastel green, or glossy red.
- **Different type of bottle:** for example, a clear glass water bottle, a sports squeeze bottle, a wine bottle, or a soda can.
- **Branding:** add a logo or label. Tell me the text, or attach your logo.
- **Your own product:** if you have a photo of it, attach it and I'll put it in this scene.

Everything else in the photo (the wooden table, the room and the lighting) will stay the same unless you want that changed too.
dialog.why: The reply asks the user to choose how the new bottle should look, offers options, and waits for their answer.
dialog.user: just make it forest green, still matte like it is now. dont touch anything else, the table and the shadow stay the same

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the change because your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created.

I tried the cheapest editing option your free plan allows: one image at 640px, which costs about 5 credits per image. Since even that was refused, any other edit would be refused too.

To go ahead, you'd need to top up your credits. You can buy a credit pack, wait for your free credits to refresh, or upgrade your plan. Once you have credits, tell me and I'll run it as you asked: the bottle turns forest green and stays matte, and the table, the shadow and everything else stay the same.
